Cobalt Strike (Malware Family)
Inventory Statistics Usage ApiVector Login SYMBOL NAME --> COMMON_NAME aka. SYNONYMS win.cobalt_strike (Back to overview) Cobalt Strike

VTCollection

Cobalt Strike is a paid penetration testing product that allows an attacker to deploy an agent named 'Beacon' on the victim machine. Beacon includes a wealth of functionality to the attacker, including, but not limited to command execution, key logging, file transfer, SOCKS proxying, privilege escalation, mimikatz, port scanning and lateral movement. Beacon is in-memory/file-less, in that it consists of stageless or multi-stage shellcode that once loaded by exploiting a vulnerability or executing a shellcode loader, will reflectively load itself into the memory of a process without touching the disk. It supports C2 and staging over HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMB named pipes as well as forward and reverse TCP; Beacons can be daisy-chained. Cobalt Strike comes with a toolkit for developing shellcode loaders, called Artifact Kit. The Beacon implant has become popular amongst targeted attackers and criminal users as it is well written, stable, and highly customizable. References × Select Content 2026-05-14

timeline.summary: The seed workstation resolved a rare domain shortly before the suspicious TLS session.
Seed JA4 alert matched a suspicious TLS beacon to rare external infrastructure.
The seed workstation reconnected to the same C2 infrastructure after the alert.
Suspicious rundll32.exe launched a loader DLL from a user-writable path shortly after the beacon sequence.
PsExec remote service creation from ws-eng-02 to ws-eng-05 followed the seed beacon traffic.
Approved SCCM patch staging began on ws-eng-05 in the same hour and could explain some routine admin activity.
Windows update content was downloaded from an approved Microsoft endpoint during the maintenance window.
A second workstation contacted the original beacon infrastructure minutes after the remote-service event.
The second workstation resolved a secondary rare domain that did not appear in the seed alert.
The second workstation pivoted to a second external IP over TLS after reaching the original beacon host.
WMI remote process creation from ws-eng-05 to ws-eng-09 followed the secondary outbound TLS traffic.
A third workstation later resolved the secondary domain that emerged only after expansion.
A QA telemetry job also touched the same hosting IP through a different vendor domain, indicating the secondary IP is shared infrastructure.
A third workstation contacted the secondary infrastructure after the WMI activity, indicating likely onward spread.
The EDR sensor on ws-eng-09 reported degraded process telemetry, so the execution lineage behind the second beacon cannot be reconstructed.

The seed workstation reconnected to the same C2 infrastructure after the alert.

Windows update content was downloaded from an approved Microsoft endpoint during the maintenance window.
A second workstation contacted the original beacon infrastructure minutes after the remote-service event.
WMI remote process creation from ws-eng-05 to ws-eng-09 followed the secondary outbound TLS traffic.
A third workstation later resolved the secondary domain that emerged only after expansion.
A QA telemetry job also touched the same hosting IP through a different vendor domain, indicating the secondary IP is shared infrastructure.

The EDR sensor on ws-eng-09 reported degraded process telemetry, so the execution lineage behind the second beacon cannot be reconstructed.

## 3. 关键证据判断

本次事件确认成立的关键在于时间线的高度连贯性和攻击行为的递进关系。种子告警并非孤立事件，调查围绕其展开，构建了从“解析罕见域名”到“建立 TLS 信标”，再到“执行可疑载荷”和“发起横向移动”的完整攻击链。尤其具有决定性的是，横向移动的明确信号（从 ws-eng-02 到 ws-eng-05 的 PsExec 远程服务创建）发生后仅数分钟，被移动的目标资产 ws-eng-05 即开始与最初的信标基础设施通信。这一系列事件的时空耦合关系，使得将 ws-eng-05 的活动独立解释为背景噪声的可能性极低，从而强有力地支撑了本次多主机安全事件的结论。

然而，必须明确当前结论的上限。尽管已确认了命令与控制通道和横向移动行为，但我们缺少更深入的证据来做出更强的断言。例如，在 ws-eng-02 上虽然观察到了 rundll32.exe 的可疑执行，但目前没有进一步的命令行参数、落地文件或内存分析来完全还原其加载的恶意代码功能，也无法确认攻击者在内存中实现了持续控制。同样地，对于 ws-eng-05 以及候选资产 ws-eng-09，其完整的执行链和失陷深度仍不清晰，特别是 ws-eng-09 上报告的 EDR 遥测降级，更是直接限制了对其行为进行深入追溯的可能性。因此，当前结论停留在“已确认多主机受信标影响”，而尚未达到“已确认攻击者完全控制、持久化驻留或数据外传”。

## 4. 影响范围、候选对象与外部基础设施

分析窗口内，已确认受到影响的资产范围包括两台主机：种子机 ws-eng-02（10.70.3.12）和后续通过 PsExec 横向移动涉及的 ws-eng-05（10.70.3.45）。ws-eng-02 是本次事件的核心起点，在其上观察到了接入、载荷执行和横向移动发起等关键行为。ws-eng-05 则作为横向移动的直接目标，随后也表现出接入同一外部 C2 基础设施的行为，表明它已被成功入侵，并成为攻击者控制链上的新节点。

核心的外部攻击基础设施是域名 sync-cdn-notify.net 及其解析地址 203.0.113.77。种子告警和两台已确认受影响资产的可疑通信均以此为最终外联目标。此外，存在多个候选的关联对象，它们不应被理解为已确认的受影响资产。资产 ws-eng-09（10.70.3.90）因观察到来自 ws-eng-05 的 WMI 远程进程创建行为以及其自身对第二跳基础设施 cdn-notify-edge.net/198.51.100.44 的信标通信，被标记为待确认对象。然而，ws-eng-09 上存在 EDR 遥测降级，且部分指向 198.51.100.44 的流量可能与共享基础设施上的正常遥测任务存在关联，这两个因素使得其是否真正受影响尚待核查。外部 IP 地址 198.51.100.44 的角色则更为复杂，它既是候选信标的目标，又被一个实验室资产 ws-lab-02 的正常遥测任务所使用，目前更应被归类为共享或背景基础设施，在进行封禁决策时需更加审慎。

## 5. 反证、替代解释与未闭合缺口

尽管攻击主线清晰，但调查过程中也发现了可以作为良性或替代解释的背景证据，这些发现限制了我们做出更强结论的能力。在 ws-eng-05 上观察到横向移动信号（09:21）和信标通信（09:28）之间的时段，该主机恰好处于一个审批过的 SCCM 补丁周期中，从微软官方的 download.windowsupdate.com 域下载了更新内容。这意味着 part of ws-eng-05 上的进程事件和网络活动可能包含了合法的系统管理行为。虽然这并不能推翻 ws-eng-05 与已知可疑 C2 的连接事实，但它确实增加了后续调查中区分攻击者活动和正常维护操作的复杂性。

此外，多个未闭合的缺口直接限制了事件结论的深度。首先，虽然我们观察到了从 ws-eng-02 开始的横向移动，但目前缺乏在不同主机上发现相同恶意文件或内存痕迹的证据来形成一个完整闭环的证据链条。其次，对于候选资产 ws-eng-09，其 EDR 遥测降级构成了一个关键的调查缺口，使得我们无法重建其背后的执行链，从而不能断定它是被同一攻击者成功入侵，还是仅存在一些被拦截的扫描探测行为。最后，攻击源头的初始接入方式、攻击者的持久化手段以及是否存在数据窃取等关键攻击阶段，在当前证据中仍是空白。这些缺口共同决定了我们目前只能确认一个以信标和横向移动为特征的事件，而不能将其定性为一次完整的定向攻击。

## 6. 处置建议与后续核查

- **隔离与监控已确认受影响主机**：对资产 ws-eng-02 和 ws-eng-05 立即执行网络隔离，同时保留内存镜像。利用 EDR 和 Sysmon 日志，重点排查 rundll32.exe 的详细命令行、所有从用户可写路径加载的 DLL、PsExec 创建的远端服务名及其可执行文件路径，以及任何未知或可疑的计划任务和注册表 Run 键，目标是定位恶意载荷落地文件和持久化机制。
- **封禁核心外部基础设施**：在边界防火墙、安全网关和 DNS 服务器上，立即封禁并监控对 IP 地址 203.0.113.77 和域名 sync-cdn-notify.net 的出站与入站流量。通过 DNS 日志、代理服务器日志和防火墙会话日志，回溯并封堵同分析窗口内任何其他内部资产与这些 IOCs 的连接记录。
- **验证候选事件与待确认对象**：对围绕着 cdn-notify-edge.net 和 IP 198.51.100.44 的所有关联事件（特别是来自 ws-eng-09 和 ws-eng-05 的事件）进行独立验证。在 EDR、DNS 和网络流日志中，查询这些指标在更大时间范围和历史数据中的出现规律，研判其是否也命中本地威胁情报或外部恶意软件数据库。若确认恶意，补充为 IOC 并立即实施封禁。
- **扩线排查同指纹指标**：利用种子告警命中的 JA4 指纹 `t13d1516h2_2ba4190accc0_13fe129f5abc`，在 NTA、TLS 解密网关或 EDR 的网络传感器日志中，检索分析窗口内及向前回溯一周的数据，查找是否还有其他内部资产存在包含此指纹的 TLS 流量，以排除潜在的其他潜伏主机。

Cobalt Strike is a paid penetration testing product that allows an attacker to deploy an agent named 'Beacon' on the victim machine. Beacon includes a wealth of functionality to the attacker, including, but not limited to command execution, key logging, file transfer, SOCKS proxying, privilege escalation, mimikatz, port scanning and lateral movement. Beacon is in-memory/file-less, in that it consists of stageless or multi-stage shellcode that once loaded by exploiting a vulnerability or executing a shellcode loader, will reflectively load itself into the memory of a process without touching the disk. It supports C2 and staging over HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMB named pipes as well as forward and reverse TCP; Beacons can be daisy-chained. Cobalt Strike comes with a toolkit for developing shellcode loaders, called Artifact Kit. The Beacon implant has become popular amongst targeted attackers and criminal users as it is well written, stable, and highly customizable. References × Select Content 2026-05-14

Inventory Statistics Usage ApiVector Login SYMBOL NAME --> COMMON_NAME aka. SYNONYMS win.cobalt_strike (Back to overview) Cobalt Strike

Cobalt Strike is a paid penetration testing product that allows an attacker to deploy an agent named 'Beacon' on the victim machine. Beacon includes a wealth of functionality to the attacker, including, but not limited to command execution, key logging, file transfer, SOCKS proxying, privilege escalation, mimikatz, port scanning and lateral movement. Beacon is in-memory/file-less, in that it consists of stageless or multi-stage shellcode that once loaded by exploiting a vulnerability or executing a shellcode loader, will reflectively load itself into the memory of a process without touching the disk. It supports C2 and staging over HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, SMB named pipes as well as forward and reverse TCP; Beacons can be daisy-chained. Cobalt Strike comes with a toolkit for developing shellcode loaders, called Artifact Kit. The Beacon implant has become popular amongst targeted attackers and criminal users as it is well written, stable, and highly customizable. References × Select Content 2026-05-14

candidate_events.summary: The second workstation resolved a secondary rare domain that did not appear in the seed alert.
The second workstation pivoted to a second external IP over TLS after reaching the original beacon host.
A third workstation contacted the secondary infrastructure after the WMI activity, indicating likely onward spread.

confirmed_events.summary: The seed workstation resolved a rare domain shortly before the suspicious TLS session.
Seed JA4 alert matched a suspicious TLS beacon to rare external infrastructure.
The seed workstation reconnected to the same C2 infrastructure after the alert.
Suspicious rundll32.exe launched a loader DLL from a user-writable path shortly after the beacon sequence.
PsExec remote service creation from ws-eng-02 to ws-eng-05 followed the seed beacon traffic.
Approved SCCM patch staging began on ws-eng-05 in the same hour and could explain some routine admin activity.
Windows update content was downloaded from an approved Microsoft endpoint during the maintenance window.
A second workstation contacted the original beacon infrastructure minutes after the remote-service event.
WMI remote process creation from ws-eng-05 to ws-eng-09 followed the secondary outbound TLS traffic.
A third workstation later resolved the secondary domain that emerged only after expansion.
A QA telemetry job also touched the same hosting IP through a different vendor domain, indicating the secondary IP is shared infrastructure.
